critical_code_review_comments: AuthPage.jsx (line 130-134) — after the successful unified /api/auth/login call, the response.data.session_token is NOT persisted to localStorage (the fallback used by ProtectedRoute's /auth/me Authorization header). Only the signup path at line 211-212 stores it. In normal browsers the HttpOnly cookie carries the session so this is transparent, but in Playwright/preview automation the cookie sometimes doesn't stick across navigations, causing a bounce to '/'. Recommend mirroring the signup behavior: `if (response.data.session_token) localStorage.setItem('session_token', response.data.session_token);` right after the login response. This will also make deep-linked navigations more robust for real users on cross-site cookie-restricted browsers.
